title: Facial Mask Murder Case
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Kogoro Mouri, Ran, Inspector Megure) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed, attributed edge between the entities involved (person/location/object), sharing an `order` integer so edges belonging to the same occurrence can be grouped without a reifying node. Chihiro's face-pack impersonation of her dead mother is a genuine, transcript-supported red herring: it looks like murder-cover-up but was only done to dodge suspicion after finding the body, and Yoshioka's hidden embezzlement report is a second, unrelated red herring the police initially treat as a murder motive. case_type: murder.

persons.name: Ikuko Kojima
persons.occupation: businesswoman, manager of a discount electronics store chain

attrs.eyesight: poor; wore contact lenses instead of glasses

attrs.false_alibi: vouched for by Kogoro Mouri as being in Beika at 9:40, which only rules him out if the murder happened after 8:50 -- once Chihiro's cover-up is exposed and the true time of death is shown to fall within his own 8:00-8:40 visit, this alibi collapses

attrs.estranged_reason: mother severed ties with her over her fiance, who is in prison
attrs.cleared_because: her face-pack impersonation of her dead mother for the security guards was a cover-up to avoid suspicion after finding the body already dead, not the murder itself -- it only shifted the apparent time of death, inadvertently creating Izumi's alibi

persons.name: Juro Yoshioka
persons.occupation: employee at Ikuko Kojima's company; first to find the body

attrs.cleared_because: the ten minutes he spent alone with the body were spent hiding a detective agency's report on his own embezzlement, not committing the murder -- Ikuko was already dead when he arrived

attrs.note: elderly landowners pressured by Ikuko into agreeing to sell their land to cover their son's investment losses

attrs.significance: could only have lodged there through direct physical contact with the victim during the struggle -- i.e., only the killer

objects.name: Face pack and bathrobe used to impersonate the victim

attrs.staging_flaw: reapplied to the corpse with no wrinkles despite the victim supposedly having worn it while struggling and dying in pain, and Chihiro forgot to remove her own purple lipstick before answering the door as her mother

attrs.found_with: Juro Yoshioka, hidden in his car for about ten minutes before he called the police
attrs.reveals: Yoshioka's embezzlement from Ikuko's company -- his real reason for tampering, unrelated to the murder itself

attrs.shows: precise arrival/departure times for Izumi (8:00-8:40) and Chihiro (8:50-9:10), establishing the apparent alibi window that Chihiro's cover-up later exposed as false

clues.desc: The face pack found on the victim had no wrinkles, despite her supposedly wearing it while struggling and dying in pain -- proving it was applied to her corpse after death, not before.

The security guard who saw 'Ikuko' answer the door recalled bright purple lips clashing with the white face pack -- Ikuko never wore lipstick, but that shade matches Chihiro's, revealing Chihiro had impersonated her already-dead mother.

edges.detail: invests 300 million yen of Ikuko's money as she instructed, and the investment fails
threatens to sue him for the full 300 million yen lost
pressures Izumi's elderly parents into agreeing to sell their land to cover his losses
asks her mother for a loan and is harshly refused, sparking a family quarrel in which she reportedly said she'd kill her mother someday
dresses in a matching robe and face pack to answer the door for the security guards after a false alarm, hiding that she'd already found her mother dead
reapplies the face pack to the corpse afterward to hide her tampering
hides the detective agency's embezzlement report in his car before calling the police, fearing it would make him the prime suspect

edges.motive_type: revenge and financial desperation -- threatened with a lawsuit and forced to sacrifice his elderly parents' land to cover his investment losses
family estrangement over her imprisoned fiance, a refused loan request, and a prior argument in which she reportedly threatened to kill her mother
fear of exposure -- Ikuko had hired a detective agency to investigate his embezzlement from her company

edges.detail: tape shows Izumi arriving 8:00 and leaving 8:40, establishing his apparent alibi window
tape shows Chihiro arriving 8:50 and leaving 9:10, an apparent alibi window later exposed as false by her cover-up
